summary: Biogen Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the execution of a Contingent Value Rights (CVR) Agreement in connection with its acquisition of Apellis Pharmaceuticals via a tender offer and merger. Under the Merger Agreement dated March 31, 2026, Biogen's subsidiary accepted all tendered shares. The CVR provides non-transferable rights to milestone cash payments: $2.00 per CVR if SYFOVRE net sales reach $1.5B in any year 2027-2030, and up to $4.00 per CVR if sales reach $2.0B in 2027-2031. Each milestone pays once. The arrangement structures contingent consideration based on product performance. Watch for sales milestones and regulatory/commercial execution on SYFOVRE.
